scenes.tts: If calcium entry needs glutamate and depolarization together, what happens when several inputs reach one cell?
scenes.visual: One CA1 cell with three coloured input wires converging on it.
scenes.narration: If calcium entry needs glutamate and depolarization together, what happens when several inputs reach one cell?

scenes.tts: Picture one C A one cell receiving separate input pathways. You can stimulate each one on its own. Three properties were measured before the gate was known. Can the gate explain them?
scenes.caption: Picture one CA1 cell receiving separate input pathways. You can stimulate each one on its own. Three properties were measured before the gate was known. Can the gate explain them?
scenes.visual: Each wire gets its own stimulator and its own time-course plot.
scenes.narration: Picture one CA1 cell receiving separate input pathways. You can stimulate each one on its own. Three properties were measured before the gate was known. Can the gate explain them?

scenes.tts: First, an input that stays silent during the train. Does it change?
scenes.visual: The grey wire stays dark while another wire is trained.
scenes.narration: First, an input that stays silent during the train. Does it change?

scenes.tts: No. It released no glutamate, so its N M D A receptors let in no calcium, however depolarized the cell became. This mechanism does not potentiate it.
scenes.caption: No. It released no glutamate, so its NMDA receptors let in no calcium, however depolarized the cell became. This mechanism does not potentiate it.
scenes.visual: The cell depolarizes, but the grey wire's spines show no glutamate and no Ca2+. Its plot stays flat.
scenes.narration: No. It released no glutamate, so its NMDA receptors let in no calcium, however depolarized the cell became. This mechanism does not potentiate it.

scenes.tts: That is input specificity. You saw it in the first recording, where the untrained control pathway stayed flat.
scenes.visual: Label: input specificity. The control pathway's flat line from chapter 1 slides in beside it.
scenes.narration: That is input specificity. You saw it in the first recording, where the untrained control pathway stayed flat.

scenes.tts: Next, a train to just a few fibres. It can fail to induce L T P. The same train to many fibres succeeds.
scenes.caption: Next, a train to just a few fibres. It can fail to induce LTP. The same train to many fibres succeeds.
scenes.visual: A train to a thin bundle: flat plot. A train to a thick bundle: the plot rises.
scenes.narration: Next, a train to just a few fibres. It can fail to induce LTP. The same train to many fibres succeeds.

scenes.tts: The balance point shows why. A few synapses barely move the local voltage, so the gate barely moves.
scenes.visual: The voltage scale: a thin AMPA rope moves the marker only from −70 to about −64 mV. Mg2+ stays put.
scenes.narration: The balance point shows why. A few synapses barely move the local voltage, so the gate barely moves.

scenes.tts: Many synapses together pull the balance point up, close to where calcium entry is greatest.
scenes.visual: A thick AMPA rope drags the marker to about −23 mV, beside the peak of the Ca2+ curve. Mg2+ pops out.
scenes.narration: Many synapses together pull the balance point up, close to where calcium entry is greatest.

scenes.tts: That is cooperativity. These voltages come from a single patch of membrane. Real dendrites differ, so read the direction, not the exact values.
scenes.visual: Label: cooperativity. A small note: single-patch numbers, illustrative.
scenes.narration: That is cooperativity. These voltages come from a single patch of membrane. Real dendrites differ, so read the direction, not the exact values.

scenes.tts: Now take two pathways, one weak and one strong. The strong one can potentiate on its own.
scenes.visual: A thin weak wire and a thick strong wire onto the same cell.
scenes.narration: Now take two pathways, one weak and one strong. The strong one can potentiate on its own.

scenes.tts: Stimulated alone, the weak pathway fails. Its spines get glutamate, but too little depolarization to clear the block.
scenes.visual: The weak wire fires alone; Mg2+ stays in most pores; its plot stays flat.
scenes.narration: Stimulated alone, the weak pathway fails. Its spines get glutamate, but too little depolarization to clear the block.

scenes.tts: Now stimulate the weak pathway during the strong pathway's train.
scenes.visual: The thin and thick wires fire at the same time.
scenes.narration: Now stimulate the weak pathway during the strong pathway's train.

scenes.tts: A third pathway gets no stimulation at all.
scenes.visual: The grey third wire stays dark.
scenes.narration: A third pathway gets no stimulation at all.

scenes.tts: Predict each pathway's slope an hour later.
scenes.visual: Three empty time-course plots, each with a question mark.
scenes.narration: Predict each pathway's slope an hour later.

scenes.tts: The strong pathway is potentiated, as before.
scenes.visual: The strong pathway's plot rises.
scenes.narration: The strong pathway is potentiated, as before.

scenes.tts: The weak pathway is potentiated too. It supplied its own glutamate. The strong input supplied the depolarization that cleared the block.
scenes.visual: The weak pathway's plot rises. At its spine, glutamate binds while depolarization arriving from the strong input clears Mg2+.
scenes.narration: The weak pathway is potentiated too. It supplied its own glutamate. The strong input supplied the depolarization that cleared the block.

scenes.tts: The third pathway stays near baseline, because it released no glutamate.
scenes.visual: The grey plot stays flat.
scenes.narration: The third pathway stays near baseline, because it released no glutamate.

scenes.tts: That is associativity, a Hebbian rule in a dish.
scenes.visual: Label: associativity, a Hebbian rule in a dish.
scenes.narration: That is associativity, a Hebbian rule in a dish.

scenes.tts: A spike fired by the cell and spreading back into the dendrite can play the strong input's part.
scenes.visual: A spike sweeps back from the cell body into the weak input's spine.
scenes.narration: A spike fired by the cell and spreading back into the dendrite can play the strong input's part.

scenes.tts: This is the shape an association needs. A weak input, like a cue, gains strength when active with a strong one, like an outcome.
scenes.visual: The weak wire is relabelled cue and the strong wire outcome.
scenes.narration: This is the shape an association needs. A weak input, like a cue, gains strength when active with a strong one, like an outcome.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: one gate, reading two signals, explains input specificity, cooperativity and associativity. That holds when the inputs depolarize the right spines enough.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card listing the three properties under the two-signal formula, with a note: when depolarization reaches the right spines.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: one gate, reading two signals, explains input specificity, cooperativity and associativity. That holds when the inputs depolarize the right spines enough.
